sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(r0,r1,c0,c1,fg='B'):
    c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if c[r][cc]==fg]
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return tuple(''.join('#' if c[r][cc]==fg else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
def gpos(i):  # pink glyph at pos i
    c0=[15,22,29,36,43][i]
    return glyph(52,56,c0,c0+4)
def bpos(i):
    c0=[15,22,29,36,43][i]
    return glyph(41,45,c0,c0+4)
# cursor currently at pos0. Map pink cycles pos1..4, confirm blue static.
cycles={}
cur=0
for target in [1,2,3,4]:
    while cur!=target:
        action(['RIGHT']); cur=(cur+1)%5
    start=gpos(target)
    bstart=bpos(target)
    cyc=[start]
    for k in range(10):
        action(['UP'])
        g=gpos(target)
        cyc.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    cycles[target]=cyc
    print(f"pos{target} blue_static={bpos(target)==bstart} cycle_len={len(cyc)-1}")
    for j,g in enumerate(cyc[:-1]):
        print("  ",j,g)
result=cycles
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(r0,r1,c0,c1,fg='B'):
    c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    pts=[(r,cc) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1) if c[r][cc]==fg]
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return tuple(''.join('#' if c[r][cc]==fg else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)) for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
def gpos(i):  # pink glyph at pos i
    c0=[15,22,29,36,43][i]
    return glyph(52,56,c0,c0+4)
def bpos(i):
    c0=[15,22,29,36,43][i]
    return glyph(41,45,c0,c0+4)
# cursor currently at pos0. Map pink cycles pos1..4, confirm blue static.
cycles={}
cur=0
for target in [1,2,3,4]:
    while cur!=target:
        action(['RIGHT']); cur=(cur+1)%5
    start=gpos(target)
    bstart=bpos(target)
    cyc=[start]
    for k in range(10):
        action(['UP'])
        g=gpos(target)
        cyc.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    cycles[target]=cyc
    print(f"pos{target} blue_static={bpos(target)==bstart} cycle_len={len(cyc)-1}")
    for j,g in enumerate(cyc[:-1]):
        print("  ",j,g)
result=cycles
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
